cmd.help.text:
🤖 **Telegram Message Forwarding Bot v{version}**

**Basic commands**
/start - Get started
/help(/h) - Show this help message

**Binding and settings**
/bind(/b) <source chat link or name> [target chat link or name] - Bind a source chat
/settings(/s) [rule ID] - Manage forwarding rules
/changelog(/cl) - View the changelog

**Forwarding rule management**
/copy_rule(/cr)  <source rule ID> [target rule ID] - Copy all settings of a rule to the current or target rule
/list_rule(/lr) - List all forwarding rules
/delete_rule(/dr) <rule ID> [rule ID] [rule ID] ... - Delete the given rules

**Keyword management**
/add(/a) <keyword> [keyword] ["key word"] ['key word'] ... - Add normal keywords
/add_regex(/ar) <regex> [regex] [regex] ... - Add regular expressions
/add_all(/aa) <keyword> [keyword] [keyword] ... - Add normal keywords to all rules bound to the current chat
/add_regex_all(/ara) <regex> [regex] [regex] ... - Add regular expressions to all rules
/list_keyword(/lk) - List all keywords
/remove_keyword(/rk) <keyword1> ["key word"] ['key word'] ... - Delete keywords
/remove_keyword_by_id(/rkbi) <ID> [ID] [ID] ... - Delete keywords by ID
/remove_all_keyword(/rak) [keyword] ["key word"] ['key word'] ... - Delete the given keywords from all rules bound to the current chat
/clear_all_keywords(/cak) - Clear all keywords of the current rule
/clear_all_keywords_regex(/cakr) - Clear all regex keywords of the current rule
/copy_keywords(/ck) <rule ID> - Copy a rule's keywords to the current rule
/copy_keywords_regex(/ckr) <rule ID> - Copy a rule's regex keywords to the current rule

**Replacement rule management**
/replace(/r) <regex> [replacement] - Add a replacement rule
/replace_all(/ra) <regex> [replacement] - Add a replacement rule to all rules
/list_replace(/lrp) - List all replacement rules
/remove_replace(/rr) <number> - Delete a replacement rule
/clear_all_replace(/car) - Clear all replacement rules of the current rule
/copy_replace(/crp) <rule ID> - Copy a rule's replacement rules to the current rule

**Import/Export**
/export_keyword(/ek) - Export the current rule's keywords
/export_replace(/er) - Export the current rule's replacement rules
/import_keyword(/ik) <send file too> - Import normal keywords
/import_regex_keyword(/irk) <send file too> - Import regex keywords
/import_replace(/ir) <send file too> - Import replacement rules

**RSS**
/delete_rss_user(/dru) [username] - Delete an RSS user
**UFB**
/ufb_bind(/ub) <domain> - Bind a UFB domain
/ufb_unbind(/uu) - Unbind a UFB domain
/ufb_item_change(/uic) - Switch the UFB sync configuration type

💡 **Tips**
• Parentheses show the short form of a command
• Angle brackets <> mean required parameters
• Square brackets [] mean optional parameters
• Import commands require sending a file at the same time
